name: Default branch went red
description: When a check fails on the default branch, find the commit that broke it, prepare a fix and ask a person before pushing.

steps.title: Find what broke the build
steps.instruction: Read the failing check output from the signal. Name the commit that introduced the failure and the reason it fails.

steps.title: Prepare the fix
steps.instruction: Fix the failure identified above on a new branch. Keep the change minimal and open a pull request.

steps.title: Merge the fix
steps.question: Merge this fix into the default branch?
